subject: Seller procurement orientation: marketplace activation & PO checklist
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Dana Moore <dana.moore@helixanalytics.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 23 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Seller procurement orientation: marketplace activation & PO checklist

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to send a concise orientation for Helix's procurement team so we can get you live on AWS/Azure/GCP marketplaces and complete the PO path. TL;DR: three deliverables from your side (onboarding form, PO, and a short vendor W9) and a few items we’ll provide to make the marketplace listing work.

What you'll find attached: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (fillable), SOW_template.docx (for reference).

Recommended next steps (quick checklist):
- Complete and return vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (fields: legal name, tax id, primary billing contact, marketplace preference).
- Send a Purchase Order referencing Redwood deal RDW-2027-013 to procurement@redwood.com (see PO instructions below).
- Attach vendor W-9 (US customers) or equivalent tax doc.

PO instructions by channel (short):
- AWS Marketplace: PO should include Redwood quote number (RDW-2027-013), indicate SaaS contract term, and be addressed to Redwood Inference, Inc. We will accept a PO plus a signature on the attached SOW if required by your internal systems.
- Azure Marketplace (ISV): Please indicate the Azure commercial marketplace listing (we’ll provide Marketplace Offer ID in the next email). Billing goes to Redwood with marketplace consumption invoicing enabled.
- GCP Marketplace: Include the SKU or provide intent to purchase via our partner reseller flow; attach PO to expedite reseller activation.

If you prefer, we can route a DocuSign for a short order form to capture signatures and speed procurement; I can get that out today once you confirm the billing contact.

Questions we typically see from procurement: payment terms, data residency, invoice cadence, reseller vs direct billing. I’ve listed the standard answers below so your finance team can triage quickly:
- Payment terms: Net 30 by default for enterprise PO; Net 45 can be considered for larger commitments.
- Data residency: Hosted in US regions by default; private deployment options available for regulated data.
- Invoicing: Monthly in arrears for usage; reserved capacity billed monthly per contract for Dedicated.

Please fill out the attached form and reply with an estimated date for the PO. Happy to hop on a 15-min call with your procurement/finance folks to walk through the form.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Director, Cloud Partnerships — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_v2.pdf (fillable PDF), SOW_template.docx (DOCX)

From: Helix Procurement <procurement@helixanalytics.com>

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the clear checklist and attachments. Quick questions from our side before we route to finance:
1) Can you confirm the Redwood vendor legal name and remit-to address (we need exact formatting for our AP system)?
2) For AWS Marketplace: will Redwood invoice us directly or via the marketplace (we have two internal workflows)?
3) Do you accept a PO referencing an order form number instead of the SOW? Our template inserts an internal routing ID and we prefer minimal attachments.

Estimated timeline: if we get answers by end of day Wednesday, we’ll target creating the PO by the following Monday (2027-02-01). If a DocuSign order form is available, that usually speeds approvals.

Regards,
Dana Moore
Senior Procurement Analyst — Helix Analytics
procurement@helixanalytics.com

(Attachment: internal_po_template_v1.xlsx)

1) Vendor remit/legal name (exact): Redwood Inference, Inc.
   Remit-to: Redwood Inference, Inc.
   1600 Willow St, Suite 600
   San Francisco, CA 94107
   EIN: 12-3456789

2) AWS Marketplace invoicing options:
   - If you purchase via AWS Marketplace (LISTING/Consumption), AWS bills you and we receive settlement through AWS (no direct invoice).
   - If you prefer direct billing (common for reserved capacity or committed contracts), please include "Direct Invoice to Redwood Inference, Inc." on the PO and send to procurement@redwood.com.

3) PO referencing order form: yes — we can accept a PO that references an order form number instead of attaching the full SOW. Please include Redwood quote RDW-2027-013 and the order form ID; our finance team will reconcile.

Next steps I can take right away:
- Generate a short DocuSign order form that includes the marketplace channel checkbox (AWS/Azure/GCP). I’ll CC Vanessa for signature authority questions.
- Provide our Marketplace Offer IDs for Azure and the AWS Seller ID so you can map your internal SKU/contract codes.

Marketplace IDs (for your intake form):
- AWS Seller ID: RW-INFERENCE-953
- Azure Offer ID: redwood-inference.offer-v2
- GCP Partner ID: partner-redwood-2027

DocuSign path: I can send a one-page order form (consumption or committed) — would you like standard Net 30?

CC: Vanessa Ortiz (Marketplace Ops) — Vanessa, can you confirm whether we should include any extra billing metadata for Helix (internal PO routing code)? Marcus, finance: if Helix indicates direct invoice we’ll need the invoice address and AP contact listed below matched to their PO.

Thanks — I’ll prepare the DocuSign if Dana confirms the billing contact and term.

Best,
Aditya
